# victorops_team (Resource)

Manages a VictorOps/Splunk OnCall team, a collection of users with on-call rotations and escalation policies. Use `victorops_team_membership` to add members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform-Team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
